1	/**
2	 * Backend client for the office-ops inventory plugin.
3	 *
4	 * Every request:
5	 *   - is prefixed with `${config.apiBaseUrl}/api/inventory/...`
6	 *   - carries `x-guard-token` (from session) and `x-site-id` / `x-device-id`
7	 *   - throws an `ApiError` with status + body on non-2xx
8	 *
9	 * The outbox flusher (syncService) calls `api.send.*`; screens call
10	 * `api.fetch.*`. When no session token is present, requests still go out
11	 * — the server replies 401 and the outbox keeps the row queued (or
12	 * the read screens fall back to local cache).
13	 */
14	
15	import { config } from '../config';
16	import { getSession } from '../auth/session';
17	import { getDeviceId } from '../utils/device';
18	
19	export class ApiError extends Error {
20	  constructor(public status: number, message: string, public body?: string) {
21	    super(message);
22	  }
23	}
24	
25	async function request<T>(path: string, init?: RequestInit): Promise<T> {
26	  const deviceId = await getDeviceId();
27	  const session = getSession();
28	  const headers: Record<string, string> = {
29	    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
30	    'X-Device-Id': deviceId,
31	    'X-Site-Id': config.siteId,
32	    ...((init?.headers as Record<string, string>) ?? {}),
33	  };
34	  if (session?.token) headers['X-Guard-Token'] = session.token;
35	
36	  const res = await fetch(`${config.apiBaseUrl}${path}`, { ...init, headers });
37	  if (!res.ok) {
38	    const text = await res.text().catch(() => '');
39	    throw new ApiError(res.status, `HTTP ${res.status} on ${path}`, text.slice(0, 500));
40	  }
41	  return res.json() as Promise<T>;
42	}
43	
44	const post = (path: string, payload: unknown) =>
45	  request<{ inserted?: boolean; id?: string; barcode?: string }>(path, {
46	    method: 'POST',
47	    body: JSON.stringify(payload),
48	  });
49	
50	export type RemoteOrderItem = {
51	  id: string;
52	  order_id: string;
53	  barcode: string | null;
54	  product_name: string;
55	  expected_qty: number;
56	  received_qty: number;
57	};
58	
59	export type RemoteOrder = {
60	  id: string;
61	  site_id: string;
62	  vendor: string | null;
63	  expected_at: string | null;
64	  arrived_at: string | null;
65	  status: string;
66	  items: RemoteOrderItem[];
67	};
68	
69	export type RemoteStockRow = {
70	  barcode: string;
71	  site_id: string;
72	  name: string;
73	  category: string | null;
74	  unit: string | null;
75	  on_hand: number;
76	  threshold: number;
77	};
78	
79	export type RemoteProduct = {
80	  barcode: string;
81	  site_id: string;
82	  name: string;
83	  category: string | null;
84	  unit: string | null;
85	};
86	
87	export type RemoteCatalogHit = {
88	  product: RemoteProduct | null;
89	  openOrderItem: RemoteOrderItem | null;
90	};
91	
92	export type RemoteCanonicalProduct = {
93	  product_id: string;
94	  site_id: string;
95	  canonical_name: string;
96	  category: string | null;
97	  hsn_code: string | null;
98	  unit: string;
99	  pack_size: number;
100	  created_at: string;
101	  updated_at: string;
102	};
103	
104	export const api = {
105	  // Login is handled by visitor's guard auth endpoint, not the inventory
106	  // plugin. Lives here so screens have one client to import.
107	  async login(input: { guardName: string; pin: string }): Promise<{
108	    token: string;
109	    guardId: string;
110	    guardName: string;
111	    language: 'hindi' | 'english';
112	  }> {
113	    const deviceId = await getDeviceId();
114	    const res = await fetch(`${config.apiBaseUrl}/api/guard/login`, {
115	      method: 'POST',
116	      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
117	      body: JSON.stringify({
118	        guardName: input.guardName,
119	        pin: input.pin,
120	        deviceId,
121	        deviceName: 'field-app',
122	      }),
123	    });
124	    if (!res.ok) {
125	      const text = await res.text().catch(() => '');
126	      // Pull the server's reason out of `{ "error": "..." }` if present so
127	      // the LoginScreen shows something actionable instead of just "Login failed".
128	      let reason = text.slice(0, 200);
129	      try {
130	        const parsed = JSON.parse(text);
131	        if (parsed && typeof parsed.error === 'string') reason = parsed.error;
132	      } catch {}
133	      throw new ApiError(res.status, reason || `Login failed (${res.status})`, text.slice(0, 500));
134	    }
135	    return res.json();
136	  },
137	
138	  // Writes (outbox-dispatched).
139	  send: {
140	    receipt: (payload: object) => post('/api/inventory/receipts', payload),
141	    product: (payload: object) => post('/api/inventory/products', payload),
142	    issue: (payload: object) => post('/api/inventory/issues', payload),
143	    reorderRequest: (payload: object) =>
144	      post('/api/inventory/reorder-requests', payload),
145	    mismatchFlag: (payload: object) =>
146	      post('/api/inventory/mismatch-flags', payload),
147	    learnBarcode: (payload: object) =>
148	      post('/api/inventory/canonical-products/learn-barcode', payload),
149	  },
150	
151	  // Reads (called by screens).
152	  fetch: {
153	    orders: () =>
154	      request<{ orders: RemoteOrder[] }>('/api/inventory/orders').then((r) => r.orders),
155	    stock: () =>
156	      request<{ stock: RemoteStockRow[] }>('/api/inventory/stock').then((r) => r.stock),
157	    alerts: () =>
158	      request<{ alerts: RemoteStockRow[] }>('/api/inventory/alerts').then((r) => r.alerts),
159	    catalog: (barcode: string) =>
160	      request<RemoteCatalogHit>(
161	        `/api/inventory/catalog/${encodeURIComponent(barcode)}`,
162	      ),
163	    normalizeName: (rawName: string) =>
164	      request<{
165	        canonical: string;
166	        language: 'en' | 'hi' | 'hinglish' | 'unknown';
167	        confidence: number;
168	        cached: boolean;
169	      }>('/api/inventory/products/normalize', {
170	        method: 'POST',
171	        body: JSON.stringify({ rawName }),
172	      }),
173	    canonicalProducts: () =>
174	      request<{ products: RemoteCanonicalProduct[] }>(
175	        '/api/inventory/canonical-products',
176	      ).then((r) => r.products),
177	  },
178	};

1	import * as Network from 'expo-network';
2	import { config } from '../config';
3	import { OutboxKind } from '../db/outbox';
4	import { markFailed, markSending, markSent, nextBatch, pendingCount } from '../db/outbox';
5	import { replaceCanonicalProducts, type CanonicalProduct } from '../db/catalog';
6	import { api } from './api';
7	
8	type Listener = (count: number, lastSyncAt: number | null) => void;
9	
10	let timer: ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | null = null;
11	let running = false;
12	let retryQueued = false;
13	let _lastSyncAt: number | null = null;
14	const listeners = new Set<Listener>();
15	
16	export function getLastSyncAt(): number | null {
17	  return _lastSyncAt;
18	}
19	
20	export function onPendingChange(l: Listener): () => void {
21	  listeners.add(l);
22	  pendingCount().then((c) => l(c, _lastSyncAt)).catch(() => {});
23	  return () => listeners.delete(l);
24	}
25	
26	async function notify() {
27	  const c = await pendingCount().catch(() => 0);
28	  listeners.forEach((l) => l(c, _lastSyncAt));
29	}
30	
31	// Dispatch table for outbox kinds. Adding a new kind = one line here
32	// + a handler in api.send.*.
33	const DISPATCH: Record<OutboxKind, (payload: object) => Promise<unknown>> = {
34	  receipt: api.send.receipt,
35	  product_registration: api.send.product,
36	  issue: api.send.issue,
37	  dispense: api.send.issue, // same endpoint, renamed in-app
38	  reorder_request: api.send.reorderRequest,
39	  mismatch_flag: api.send.mismatchFlag,
40	  learn_barcode: api.send.learnBarcode,
41	};
42	
43	export async function flushOnce(): Promise<{ sent: number; failed: number }> {
44	  if (running) {
45	    // Queue a retry so manual "Sync Now" taps aren't silently dropped.
46	    retryQueued = true;
47	    return { sent: 0, failed: 0 };
48	  }
49	  running = true;
50	  let sent = 0;
51	  let failed = 0;
52	  try {
53	    const net = await Network.getNetworkStateAsync().catch(() => ({ isConnected: false }));
54	    if (!net.isConnected) return { sent, failed };
55	
56	    const batch = await nextBatch(config.outboxBatchSize);
57	    for (const row of batch) {
58	      const dispatch = DISPATCH[row.kind];
59	      if (!dispatch) {
60	        await markFailed(row.id, `Unknown kind: ${row.kind}`);
61	        failed++;
62	        continue;
63	      }
64	      try {
65	        await markSending(row.id);
66	        await dispatch(JSON.parse(row.payload));
67	        await markSent(row.id);
68	        sent++;
69	      } catch (err) {
70	        await markFailed(row.id, err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err));
71	        failed++;
72	      }
73	    }
74	    if (sent > 0 || failed > 0) {
75	      _lastSyncAt = Date.now();
76	    }
77	
78	    // Pull latest canonical products catalog on each sync cycle.
79	    // This is lightweight (just a GET) and ensures guards always
80	    // have the latest admin-curated product names.
81	    await syncCanonicalProducts().catch(() => {});
82	  } finally {
83	    running = false;
84	    await notify();
85	  }
86	
87	  // If someone tapped "Sync Now" while we were busy, run again.
88	  if (retryQueued) {
89	    retryQueued = false;
90	    return flushOnce();
91	  }
92	
93	  return { sent, failed };
94	}
95	
96	/**
97	 * Pull the canonical product catalog from the backend and replace
98	 * the local SQLite cache. Guards pick from this list — keeping it
99	 * fresh is essential for the catalog-only gate flow.
100	 */
101	export async function syncCanonicalProducts(): Promise<void> {
102	  try {
103	    const remote = await api.fetch.canonicalProducts();
104	    const local: CanonicalProduct[] = remote.map((r) => ({
105	      product_id: r.product_id,
106	      canonical_name: r.canonical_name,
107	      category: r.category,
108	      hsn_code: r.hsn_code,
109	      unit: r.unit,
110	      pack_size: r.pack_size,
111	      updated_at: Date.now(),
112	    }));
113	    await replaceCanonicalProducts(local);
114	  } catch {
115	    // Non-fatal: guards can still use the last cached catalog.
116	  }
117	}
118	
119	export function startSync(): void {
120	  if (timer) return;
121	  flushOnce().catch(() => {});
122	  timer = setInterval(() => {
123	    flushOnce().catch(() => {});
124	  }, config.syncIntervalMs);
125	}
126	
127	export function stopSync(): void {
128	  if (timer) clearInterval(timer);
129	  timer = null;
130	}
131

880	export async function findOpenItemByProductId(
881	  siteId: string,
882	  productId: string,
883	): Promise<InventoryOrderItem | null> {
884	  const db = await getDb();
885	  const result = await db.execute({
886	    sql: `
887	      SELECT oi.* FROM inventory_order_items oi
888	      JOIN inventory_orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id
889	      WHERE oi.product_id = ? AND o.site_id = ? AND o.status = 'open'
890	      ORDER BY o.expected_at ASC NULLS LAST
891	      LIMIT 1
892	    `,
893	    args: [productId, siteId],
894	  });
895	  return (result.rows[0] as InventoryOrderItem | undefined) ?? null;
896	}

45	export async function apiRequest<T>(
46	  method: string,
47	  path: string,
48	  body?: unknown,
49	): Promise<ApiResult<T>> {
50	  const headers: Record<string, string> = {
51	    Accept: "application/json",
52	  };
53	  if (body !== undefined) headers["Content-Type"] = "application/json";
54	
55	  const token = getAdminToken();
56	  if (token) headers.Authorization = `Bearer ${token}`;
57	
58	  try {
59	    const response = await fetch(`${apiOrigin}${path}`, {
60	      method,
61	      headers,
62	      body: body === undefined ? undefined : JSON.stringify(body),
63	    });
64	    const data = await response.json().catch(() => ({}));
65	    return {
66	      ok: response.ok,
67	      status: response.status,
68	      data: data as T,
69	    };
70	  } catch (error) {
71	    return {
72	      ok: false,
73	      status: 0,
74	      data: { error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Network error" } as T,
75	    };
76	  }
77	}

109	async function authenticate(
110	  req: IncomingMessage,
111	  res: ServerResponse,
112	): Promise<AuthedRequest | null> {
113	  const token =
114	    header(req, "x-guard-token") ??
115	    (parseUrl(req.url ?? "", true).query["token"] as string | undefined);
116	  if (!token) {
117	    json(res, 401, { error: "Missing x-guard-token" });
118	    return null;
119	  }

121	  if (!session) {
122	    json(res, 401, { error: "Invalid or expired session" });
123	    return null;
124	  }
125	  const siteId = header(req, "x-site-id");
126	  if (!siteId) {
127	    json(res, 400, { error: "Missing x-site-id" });
128	    return null;

130	  return {
131	    guardId: session.guardId,
132	    guardName: session.guardName,
133	    siteId,
134	    deviceId: header(req, "x-device-id") ?? null,
135	  };
136	}

import { toast } from "sonner";

export function toastSuccess(message: string, description?: string) {
  toast.success(message, description ? { description } : undefined);
}

export function toastError(error: unknown, fallback = "Something went wrong") {
  const message = errorMessage(error, fallback);
  toast.error(message);
}

export function toastInfo(message: string, description?: string) {
  toast(message, description ? { description } : undefined);
}

export function errorMessage(error: unknown, fallback = "Something went wrong"): string {
  if (!error) return fallback;
  if (typeof error === "string") return error;
  if (error instanceof Error && error.message) return error.message;
  if (typeof error === "object" && error !== null) {
    const maybeMessage = (error as { message?: unknown }).message;
    if (typeof maybeMessage === "string" && maybeMessage) return maybeMessage;
  }
  return fallback;
}

export { toast };

> AGENT

Clean compile across all three projects. Summary:

**Backend** (`office-ops-engine`)
- `routes.ts`: `authenticate()` now accepts admin Bearer tokens (via visitor's `resolveAdminSession`) as a fallback to the guard token, so the dashboard can call inventory endpoints.
- Compliance endpoints added: `GET /api/inventory/compliance` (JSON) and `GET /api/inventory/compliance/export.csv`.
- `inventory_receipts` gains `product_id` + `expiry_date` columns; `insertReceipt` and the receipt POST route now persist them; `listComplianceLog` joins receipts → orders → canonical_products → guards.

**Field app**
- ReceivingScreen receipt payload includes `product_id`.
- CatalogPickerScreen typo fixes (pre-existing TS errors).

**Dashboard** (`ops-dashboard`)
- New `src/api/inventory.ts` with typed helpers + base64/CSV blob download.
- New `src/modules/inventory/InventorySection.tsx` — 4-tab UI: **Upload bill**, **Unresolved** (resolve to existing or create-new-and-map), **Catalog** (list + create canonical products), **Compliance** (date-ranged log + CSV export).
- `main.tsx`: section dispatcher renders `<InventorySection />` for `"inventory"`, replacing the placeholder.
- `apiRequest` accepts an `extraHeaders` argument so the inventory client can attach `X-Site-Id`.

**Not done / next**
- Site ID is read from `VITE_OPS_SITE_ID` (default `"default"`). If you need multi-site selection in the dashboard, that's a separate UI.
- Receipt-detail/audit deep-link from Compliance row → bill view (could be added).
- I can't smoke-test the UI from here per the dashboard's CLAUDE.md rule; please `bun run dev` and click through Upload → Unresolved → Catalog → Compliance before deploy.

Expression-based unique\n    -- index because Postgres rejects COALESCE inside a UNIQUE constraint.\n    CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS uq_product_aliases_raw_hsn\n      ON product_aliases (site_id, raw_name, COALESCE(hsn_code, ''));\n    CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_product_aliases_lookup ON product_aliases(site_id, raw_name);\n    CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_product_aliases_product ON product_aliases(product_id);"

> AGENT

Fixed. The `product_aliases` table had `UNIQUE(site_id, raw_name, COALESCE(hsn_code, ''))` — Postgres doesn't allow expressions inside `UNIQUE` table constraints. Moved it to a `CREATE UNIQUE INDEX` with the same expression, which is the supported form.

Restart `npm run start:backend` and the schema should apply cleanly.

10	/**
11	 * Union of every product the device knows about: locally-registered
12	 * products + every row mirrored from the remote stock cache. Used by
13	 * the fuzzy-suggest hook so the user can be offered an existing name
14	 * before they type it out from scratch (or misspell it).
15	 *
16	 * Dedups on barcode, preferring the locally-registered product entry
17	 * when both sources have it (it's the authoritative name on this device).
18	 */
19	export async function listKnownProducts(): Promise<KnownProduct[]> {
20	  const db = await getDb();
21	  const rows = await db.getAllAsync<KnownProduct>(`
22	    SELECT barcode, name, category, unit FROM products
23	    UNION
24	    SELECT barcode, name, category, unit FROM stock_levels
25	    WHERE barcode NOT IN (SELECT barcode FROM products)
26	    ORDER BY name COLLATE NOCASE
27	  `);
28	  return rows;
29	}

47	  );

50	export async function findCanonicalProductById(
51	  productId: string,
52	): Promise<CanonicalProduct | null> {
53	  const db = await getDb();
54	  return db.getFirstAsync<CanonicalProduct>(
55	    'SELECT * FROM canonical_products WHERE product_id = ?',
56	    [productId],
57	  );
58	}

60	export async function findCanonicalProductByBarcode(
61	  barcode: string,
62	): Promise<CanonicalProduct | null> {
63	  const db = await getDb();
64	  return db.getFirstAsync<CanonicalProduct>(
65	    `SELECT cp.* FROM canonical_products cp
66	     JOIN product_barcodes pb ON pb.product_id = cp.product_id
67	     WHERE pb.barcode = ?`,
68	    [barcode],
69	  );
70	}

72	export async function upsertCanonicalProduct(product: CanonicalProduct): Promise<void> {
73	  const db = await getDb();
74	  await db.runAsync(
75	    `INSERT INTO canonical_products (product_id, canonical_name, category, hsn_code, unit, pack_size, updated_at)
76	     VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
77	     ON CONFLICT(product_id) DO UPDATE SET
78	       canonical_name = excluded.canonical_name,
79	       category = excluded.category,
80	       hsn_code = excluded.hsn_code,
81	       unit = excluded.unit,
82	       pack_size = excluded.pack_size,
83	       updated_at = excluded.updated_at`,
84	    [
85	      product.product_id,
86	      product.canonical_name,
87	      product.category,
88	      product.hsn_code,
89	      product.unit,
90	      product.pack_size,
91	      product.updated_at,
92	    ],
93	  );
94	}
95	
96	/**
97	 * Replace the entire canonical product catalog with fresh data
98	 * from the backend. Used during full sync.
99	 */
100	export async function replaceCanonicalProducts(
101	  products: CanonicalProduct[],
102	): Promise<void> {
103	  const db = await getDb();
104	  await db.execAsync('DELETE FROM canonical_products');
105	  for (const p of products) {
106	    await upsertCanonicalProduct(p);
107	  }
108	}

126	       product_id = excluded.product_id,
127	       learned_from = excluded.learned_from,
128	       learned_at = excluded.learned_at`,
129	    [barcode, productId, learnedFrom, now()],
130	  );
131	}

1	import { getDb } from './database';
2	
3	export type Order = {
4	  id: string;
5	  vendor: string | null;
6	  expected_at: number | null;
7	  status: string;
8	  updated_at: number;
9	};
10	
11	export type OrderItem = {
12	  id: string;
13	  order_id: string;
14	  barcode: string | null;
15	  product_name: string;
16	  expected_qty: number;
17	  received_qty: number;
18	};
19	
20	export async function listOpenOrders(): Promise<Order[]> {
21	  const db = await getDb();
22	  return db.getAllAsync<Order>(
23	    `SELECT * FROM orders WHERE status = 'open' ORDER BY expected_at ASC NULLS LAST`
24	  );
25	}
26	
27	export async function getOrderItems(orderId: string): Promise<OrderItem[]> {
28	  const db = await getDb();
29	  return db.getAllAsync<OrderItem>(
30	    'SELECT * FROM order_items WHERE order_id = ?',
31	    [orderId]
32	  );
33	}
34	
35	export async function findOpenItemByBarcode(barcode: string): Promise<OrderItem | null> {
36	  const db = await getDb();
37	  return (
38	    (await db.getFirstAsync<OrderItem>(
39	      `SELECT oi.* FROM order_items oi
40	       JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id
41	       WHERE oi.barcode = ? AND o.status = 'open'
42	       ORDER BY o.expected_at ASC LIMIT 1`,
43	      [barcode]
44	    )) ?? null
45	  );
46	}
47	
48	export async function addReceivedQty(itemId: string, delta: number): Promise<void> {
49	  const db = await getDb();
50	  await db.runAsync(
51	    'UPDATE order_items SET received_qty = received_qty + ? WHERE id = ?',
52	    [delta, itemId]
53	  );
54	}

1	/**
2	 * Bill Extractor — OCR + LLM bill photo → structured line items.
3	 *
4	 * Takes a bill photo (base64 or URL) and extracts structured data:
5	 * vendor name, bill number, bill date, line items with HSN/qty/rate,
6	 * and totals. Uses the same LLM pipeline as the domain classifier.
7	 *
8	 * Output feeds into the bill-matcher for canonical product resolution.
9	 */
10	
11	import { mastra } from "../../index";
12	
13	export type BillLineItem = {
14	  sr_no: number;
15	  hsn_code: string | null;
16	  tax_category: string | null;
17	  item_purchased: string;
18	  qty: number;
19	  rate: number | null;
20	  value: number | null;
21	  unit: string | null;
22	};
23	
24	export type ExtractedBill = {
25	  vendor_name: string | null;
26	  bill_number: string | null;
27	  bill_date: string | null;
28	  line_items: BillLineItem[];
29	  grand_total: number | null;
30	  tax_total: number | null;
31	};
32	
33	const EXTRACTION_PROMPT = `You are a bill/receipt data extractor for an Indian office operations system.
34	
35	Given an image of a vendor bill or receipt, extract ALL line items and metadata into structured JSON.
36	
37	Bill columns typically include: SR NO., HSN, TAX CATEGORY, ITEM(S) PURCHASED, QTY, RATE (Rs.), VALUE (Rs.)
38	
39	Return ONLY valid JSON in this exact format (no markdown fences, no explanation):
40	{
41	  "vendor_name": "string or null",
42	  "bill_number": "string or null",
43	  "bill_date": "YYYY-MM-DD or null",
44	  "line_items": [
45	    {
46	      "sr_no": 1,
47	      "hsn_code": "1905 or null",
48	      "tax_category": "GST 18% or null",
49	      "item_purchased": "exact text from bill",
50	      "qty": 3,
51	      "rate": 10.00,
52	      "value": 30.00,
53	      "unit": "pcs or kg or ml or null (infer from item name if possible)"
54	    }
55	  ],
56	  "grand_total": 800.00,
57	  "tax_total": 50.00
58	}
59	
60	Rules:
61	- Extract EVERY line item, even if partially legible
62	- Preserve the EXACT item name as written on the bill (do not correct spelling)
63	- HSN codes are typically 4-8 digit numbers
64	- If a field is not visible or not present, use null
65	- qty and rate must be numbers, not strings
66	- If the bill is in Hindi, still extract item names in the original script
67	- bill_date should be converted to YYYY-MM-DD format if possible`;
68	
69	function parseExtractedBill(text: string): ExtractedBill | null {
70	  // Strip markdown code fences if present
71	  const cleaned = text
72	    .trim()
73	    .replace(/^```(?:json)?/i, "")
74	    .replace(/```$/, "")
75	    .trim();
76	
77	  // Find the outermost JSON object
78	  const start = cleaned.indexOf("{");
79	  const end = cleaned.lastIndexOf("}");
80	  if (start === -1 || end === -1) return null;
81	
82	  try {
83	    const parsed = JSON.parse(cleaned.slice(start, end + 1));
84	
85	    if (!Array.isArray(parsed.line_items)) return null;
86	
87	    return {
88	      vendor_name: parsed.vendor_name ?? null,
89	      bill_number: parsed.bill_number ?? null,
90	      bill_date: parsed.bill_date ?? null,
91	      line_items: parsed.line_items.map(
92	        (item: Record<string, unknown>, idx: number) => ({
93	          sr_no: Number(item.sr_no ?? idx + 1),
94	          hsn_code: item.hsn_code ? String(item.hsn_code) : null,
95	          tax_category: item.tax_category
96	            ? String(item.tax_category)
97	            : null,
98	          item_purchased: String(item.item_purchased ?? "Unknown"),
99	          qty: Number(item.qty ?? 1),
100	          rate: item.rate != null ? Number(item.rate) : null,
101	          value: item.value != null ? Number(item.value) : null,
102	          unit: item.unit ? String(item.unit) : null,
103	        }),
104	      ),
105	      grand_total:
106	        parsed.grand_total != null ? Number(parsed.grand_total) : null,
107	      tax_total:
108	        parsed.tax_total != null ? Number(parsed.tax_total) : null,
109	    };
110	  } catch {
111	    return null;
112	  }
113	}
114	
115	/**
116	 * Extract structured bill data from a photo.
117	 *
118	 * @param imageSource - Either a base64-encoded image string or a URL
119	 * @param mimeType - MIME type of the image (default: image/jpeg)
120	 */
121	export async function extractBillFromImage(
122	  imageSource: string,
123	  mimeType: string = "image/jpeg",
124	): Promise<{
125	  success: boolean;
126	  bill: ExtractedBill | null;
127	  error?: string;
128	}> {
129	  const agent = mastra.getAgent("inventoryAgent");
130	  if (!agent) {
131	    return {
132	      success: false,
133	      bill: null,
134	      error: "inventoryAgent not available",
135	    };
136	  }
137	
138	  const isUrl =
139	    imageSource.startsWith("http://") || imageSource.startsWith("https://");
140	
141	  const imageContent = isUrl
142	    ? { type: "image" as const, image: new URL(imageSource) }
143	    : {
144	        type: "image" as const,
145	        image: imageSource,
146	        mimeType,
147	      };
148	
149	  try {
150	    const result = (await agent.generate([
151	      { role: "system", content: EXTRACTION_PROMPT },
152	      {
153	        role: "user",
154	        content: [
155	          imageContent,
156	          {
157	            type: "text" as const,
158	            text: "Extract all line items from this bill/receipt image.",
159	          },
160	        ],
161	      },
162	    ])) as { text?: string };
163	
164	    const text = result.text ?? "";
165	    const bill = parseExtractedBill(text);
166	
167	    if (!bill) {
168	      return {
169	        success: false,
170	        bill: null,
171	        error: `Failed to parse LLM response: ${text.slice(0, 200)}`,
172	      };
173	    }
174	
175	    // Basic validation
176	    if (bill.line_items.length === 0) {
177	      return {
178	        success: false,
179	        bill,
180	        error: "No line items extracted from bill",
181	      };
182	    }
183	
184	    return { success: true, bill };
185	  } catch (error) {
186	    return {
187	      success: false,
188	      bill: null,
189	      error: `LLM extraction failed: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)}`,
190	    };
191	  }
192	}
193

Done. Changes:

- **Backend** (`bill-extractor.ts`): When `mimeType` is `application/pdf`, the LLM content part is sent as `{ type: "file", data, mimeType }` instead of `{ type: "image", … }`. Images keep the existing path. The route already forwards `mime_type`, so no route changes needed.
- **Dashboard** (`InventorySection.tsx`): file input now accepts `image/*,application/pdf`; preview renders a PDF via `<object>` for PDFs and `<img>` for images. Helper text updated.

Hot-reloads on its own — no rebuild. Upload a PDF bill to test; the Gemini model behind `inventoryAgent` handles PDF natively.

\"\", true).query;\n    const from = typeof q.from === \"string\" ? q.from : null;\n    const to = typeof q.to === \"string\" ? q.to : null;\n    const rows = await listComplianceLog(auth.siteId, from, to);\n    json(res, 200, { rows });\n    return true;\n  }\n\n  // ── Compliance Google Sheet integration ──────────────────────\n  //   GET  /api/inventory/compliance/sheet-info — does Sheets work?\n  //   POST /api/inventory/compliance/sheet-sync — push all rows now\n  if (\n    pathname === \"/api/inventory/compliance/sheet-info\" &&\n    method === \"GET\"\n  ) {\n    const auth = await authenticate(req, res);\n    if (!auth) return true;\n    const spreadsheetId = process.env.GOOGLE_SHEETS_ID ?? null;\n    const configured = Boolean(\n      spreadsheetId &&\n        (process.env.GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY_JSON ||\n          process.env.GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY_PATH),\n    );\n    json(res, 200, {\n      configured,\n      spreadsheetId,\n      url: spreadsheetId\n        ? `https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/${spreadsheetId}/edit#gid=0`\n        : null,\n      tab: \"Inventory Compliance\",\n    });\n    return true;\n  }\n\n  if (\n    pathname === \"/api/inventory/compliance/sheet-sync\" &&\n    method === \"POST\"\n  ) {\n    const auth = await authenticate(req, res);\n    if (!auth) return true;\n    const body = await readBodyJson(req);\n    const from = asString(body.from);\n    const to = asString(body.to);\n    const rows = await listComplianceLog(auth.siteId, from, to);\n    let appended = 0;\n    let failed = 0;\n    for (const r of rows) {\n      try {\n        await appendToSheetDirect(\"Inventory Compliance\", complianceRowToSheetValues(r));\n        appended++;\n      } catch (err) {\n        logError(\"[Inventory] sheet sync row failed\", err, { scope: \"inventory.sheets\" });\n        failed++;\n      }\n    }\n    json(res, 200, { appended, failed, total: rows.length });\n    return true;\n  }\n\n  return false;\n}\n\n// ─── Sheets helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────\n\nfunction complianceRowToSheetValues(r: ComplianceLogRow): string[] {\n  // Order must match INVENTORY_COMPLIANCE_HEADERS in google-sheets.ts\n  // ['Date','Bill Number','Vendor','Bill Item Name','Canonical Product',\n  //  'HSN Code','Unit','Expected Qty','Received Qty','Match Method',\n  //  'Confidence','Guard Name','Status']\n  const s = (v: unknown) => (v === null || v === undefined ? \"\" : String(v));\n  return [\n    s(r.date),\n    s(r.bill_number),\n    s(r.vendor),\n    s(r.product_name),\n    s(r.product_name),\n    s(r.hsn_code),\n    s(r.unit),\n    s(r.expected_qty),\n    s(r.qty_received),\n    \"\",\n    \"\",\n    s(r.received_by),\n    s(r.status),\n  ];\n}\n\nasync function appendComplianceRow(siteId: string, receiptId: string): Promise<void> {\n  // Pull the single row for this receipt and push it.\n  const rows = await listComplianceLog(siteId, null, null);\n  const row = rows.find((r) => r.scanned_at && receiptId);\n  // listComplianceLog doesn't filter by receipt id today; rather than\n  // re-querying, just append the freshest matching row (top of DESC list).\n  const head = rows[0];\n  const target = row ??   "new_string": "export async function getComplianceLogForReceipt(\n  siteId: string,\n  receiptId: string,\n): Promise<ComplianceLogRow | null> {\n  const db = await getDb();\n  const result = await db.execute({\n    sql: `\n      SELECT\n        r.scanned_at,\n        to_char(r.scanned_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS date,\n        io.vendor AS vendor,\n        io.bill_number AS bill_number,\n        COALESCE(r.product_id, oi.product_id) AS product_id,\n        COALESCE(cp.canonical_name, r.product_name) AS product_name,\n        cp.category AS category,\n        COALESCE(cp.hsn_code, oi.hsn_code) AS hsn_code,\n        cp.unit AS unit,\n        cp.pack_size AS pack_size,\n        r.qty AS qty_received,\n        oi.expected_qty AS expected_qty,\n        oi.unit_rate AS unit_rate,\n        (r.qty * COALESCE(oi.unit_rate, 0)) AS line_value,\n        r.expiry_date AS expiry_date,\n        COALESCE(g.name, r.guard_id) AS received_by,\n        CASE\n          WHEN oi.expected_qty IS NOT NULL AND r.qty <> oi.expected_qty THEN 'MISMATCH'\n          ELSE 'OK'\n        END AS status\n      FROM inventory_receipts r\n      LEFT JOIN inventory_order_items oi ON oi.id = r.order_item_id\n      LEFT JOIN inventory_orders io ON io.id = r.order_id\n      LEFT JOIN canonical_products cp ON cp.product_id = COALESCE(r.product_id, oi.product_id)\n      LEFT JOIN guards g ON g.id = r.guard_id\n      WHERE r.id = ? AND r.site_id = ?\n      LIMIT 1\n    `,\n    args: [receiptId, siteId],\n  });\n  const row = (result.rows[0] as unknown as ComplianceLogRow | undefined) ?? null;\n  return row;\n}\n\nexport async function listComplianceLog("
}

**Summary of this round:**

1. **Excel CSV → Google Sheet link.** Removed the CSV download route + button. Compliance tab now shows the linked sheet URL (from `GOOGLE_SHEETS_ID` env) and a "Sync range to sheet" button. Every new receipt is auto-appended to the `"Inventory Compliance"` tab via the existing `appendToSheetDirect` helper. Needs `GOOGLE_SHEETS_ID` + `GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY_PATH`/`KEY_JSON` set on the backend.

2. **Bill upload shows only unresolved items.** Matched lines go silently into the order; the upload result panel now only lists items where matching failed, plus a "Resolve N items →" CTA that switches to the Unresolved tab.

3. **The "item with tick inside other card" issue** was an artifact of showing matched + unresolved together; gone with #2.

4. **"Existing button does nothing" + "catalog not reflected in app/Pick Product"** — both were almost certainly the CORS preflight failure from the previous turn (the dashboard was sending `X-Site-Id`, which the top-level server CORS list didn't allow, so every dashboard → backend call died with `TypeError: Failed to fetch`). With that fixed (`x-site-id`, `x-device-id` added to allowed headers in `server.ts`) and the backend restarted, product creation should succeed; the field app's periodic catalog sync will pull them in on the next cycle.

   If after restart the catalog tab is still empty, no products were ever created — open Catalog tab → "New product" to seed one and confirm the round-trip works. Same for the field app — after sync, the Pick Product screen reads from local SQLite, so pull-to-refresh / restart the app to force `syncCanonicalProducts()` to run.

You're right — I had the flow wrong. Let me restate what I'm building so we're aligned, then I'll execute:

**New flow:**
1. Admin uploads bill → OCR/LLM extracts items (name, HSN, qty, price).
2. Backend returns an **editable** list. For each row, the system looks up the catalog and proposes a suggested match (using the normalizer + fuzzy + LLM hint). Admin can edit name/HSN/qty/rate/unit/pack_size, accept a suggestion (maps to existing canonical), or leave unmatched (creates new canonical on save).
3. Admin clicks **Validate** → server commits: creates new canonical products as needed, writes order + order_items, appends rows to Google Sheet's **"Ordered"** tab.
4. Field app sees these as expected deliveries.
5. Guard scans → first time picks from catalog, learns barcode → product+unit+pack. Next time, auto-resolves; quantity only. On confirm, row appends to Google Sheet's **"Received"** tab. Display shows `name` and right-aligned `pack_size unit` (e.g. `20 g`).
6. Google Sheets: same attach/detach UX as before, with **two tabs** (Ordered, Received).

I'll build this in this order: backend `bills/extract` + `bills/validate` split with per-item suggestions → dashboard editable validation UI → Sheets two-tab. Field-app already shows `unit · pack_size`; I'll make it prominent.

1	/**
2	 * Bill Matcher — maps vendor bill line items to canonical products.
3	 *
4	 * Multi-step matching pipeline:
5	 *   1. Exact name match against canonical_products
6	 *   2. Product alias cache hit (raw_name + optional HSN context)
7	 *   3. HSN-scoped fuzzy match (Fuse.js within same HSN category)
8	 *   4. LLM normalization (existing normalizer.ts)
9	 *   5. Unresolved → admin queue
10	 *
11	 * Each successful match learns an alias for future free lookups.
12	 * Over time, the alias cache grows and the LLM is called less.
13	 */
14	
15	import { nanoid } from "nanoid";
16	import type { BillLineItem, ExtractedBill } from "./bill-extractor";
17	import {
18	  createOrderFromBill,
19	  createOrderItemFromBill,
20	  findCanonicalProductByName,
21	  findProductAlias,
22	  insertUnresolvedBillItem,
23	  listCanonicalProductsByHsn,
24	  saveProductAlias,
25	  type CanonicalProduct,
26	} from "./db";
27	import { normalizeProductName } from "./normalizer";
28	
29	export type MatchResult = {
30	  matched: boolean;
31	  productId: string | null;
32	  canonicalName: string;
33	  confidence: number;
34	  method: "exact" | "alias" | "hsn_fuzzy" | "normalized" | "unresolved";
35	};
36	
37	/**
38	 * Simple fuzzy name comparison. Returns a similarity score 0-1.
39	 * Avoids pulling in Fuse.js server-side for a simple use case.
40	 */
41	function fuzzyScore(a: string, b: string): number {
42	  const la = a.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, "");
43	  const lb = b.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, "");
44	  if (la === lb) return 1.0;
45	  if (la.includes(lb) || lb.includes(la)) return 0.8;
46	
47	  // Bigram similarity (Dice coefficient)
48	  const bigramsA = new Set<string>();
49	  for (let i = 0; i < la.length - 1; i++) bigramsA.add(la.slice(i, i + 2));
50	  const bigramsB = new Set<string>();
51	  for (let i = 0; i < lb.length - 1; i++) bigramsB.add(lb.slice(i, i + 2));
52	
53	  if (bigramsA.size === 0 || bigramsB.size === 0) return 0;
54	
55	  let intersection = 0;
56	  for (const bg of bigramsA) {
57	    if (bigramsB.has(bg)) intersection++;
58	  }
59	  return (2 * intersection) / (bigramsA.size + bigramsB.size);
60	}
61	
62	/**
63	 * Match a single bill line item to a canonical product.
64	 */
65	export async function matchBillLineToProduct(
66	  siteId: string,
67	  item: BillLineItem,
68	): Promise<MatchResult> {
69	  const name = item.item_purchased.trim();
70	  const hsn = item.hsn_code?.trim() || null;
71	
72	  // Step 1: Exact name match in canonical_products
73	  const exact = await findCanonicalProductByName(siteId, name);
74	  if (exact) {
75	    return {
76	      matched: true,
77	      productId: exact.product_id,
78	      canonicalName: exact.canonical_name,
79	      confidence: 1.0,
80	      method: "exact",
81	    };
82	  }
83	
84	  // Step 2: Product alias cache hit (HSN-aware)
85	  const alias = await findProductAlias(siteId, name, hsn);
86	  if (alias && alias.confidence >= 0.7) {
87	    return {
88	      matched: true,
89	      productId: alias.product_id,
90	      canonicalName: alias.raw_name,
91	      confidence: alias.confidence,
92	      method: "alias",
93	    };
94	  }
95	
96	  // Step 3: HSN-scoped fuzzy match
97	  if (hsn) {
98	    const candidates = await listCanonicalProductsByHsn(siteId, hsn);
99	    if (candidates.length > 0) {
100	      let bestMatch: CanonicalProduct | null = null;
101	      let bestScore = 0;
102	
103	      for (const candidate of candidates) {
104	        const score = fuzzyScore(name, candidate.canonical_name);
105	        if (score > bestScore) {
106	          bestScore = score;
107	          bestMatch = candidate;
108	        }
109	      }
110	
111	      if (bestMatch && bestScore >= 0.6) {
112	        // Learn this alias for next time
113	        await saveProductAlias({
114	          id: `pa_${nanoid(12)}`,
115	          siteId,
116	          rawName: name,
117	          productId: bestMatch.product_id,
118	          hsnCode: hsn,
119	          confidence: bestScore,
120	          source: "hsn_fuzzy",
121	        });
122	
123	        return {
124	          matched: true,
125	          productId: bestMatch.product_id,
126	          canonicalName: bestMatch.canonical_name,
127	          confidence: bestScore,
128	          method: "hsn_fuzzy",
129	        };
130	      }
131	    }
132	  }
133	
134	  // Step 4: LLM normalization
135	  try {
136	    const normalized = await normalizeProductName({ siteId, rawName: name });
137	    if (normalized.confidence >= 0.7) {
138	      const product = await findCanonicalProductByName(
139	        siteId,
140	        normalized.canonical,
141	      );
142	      if (product) {
143	        // Learn alias
144	        await saveProductAlias({
145	          id: `pa_${nanoid(12)}`,
146	          siteId,
147	          rawName: name,
148	          productId: product.product_id,
149	          hsnCode: hsn,
150	          confidence: normalized.confidence,
151	          source: "llm_normalized",
152	        });
153	
154	        return {
155	          matched: true,
156	          productId: product.product_id,
157	          canonicalName: product.canonical_name,
158	          confidence: normalized.confidence,
159	          method: "normalized",
160	        };
161	      }
162	    }
163	  } catch {
164	    // LLM failed — fall through to unresolved
165	  }
166	
167	  // Step 5: Unresolved
168	  return {
169	    matched: false,
170	    productId: null,
171	    canonicalName: name,
172	    confidence: 0,
173	    method: "unresolved",
174	  };
175	}

178	 * Process an entire extracted bill: match each line item, create
179	 * an order, and queue unresolved items for admin resolution.

181	 * Returns the created order ID and per-line-item match results.
182	 */
183	export async function processBill(
184	  siteId: string,
185	  bill: ExtractedBill,
186	  billPhotoUrl?: string | null,
187	): Promise<{
188	  orderId: string;
189	  results: Array<{
190	    lineItem: BillLineItem;
191	    match: MatchResult;
192	    orderItemId: string | null;
193	  }>;
194	  summary: {
195	    total: number;
196	    matched: number;
197	    unresolved: number;
198	  };
199	}> {
200	  const orderId = `ord_${nanoid(12)}`;
201	
202	  // Create the order
203	  await createOrderFromBill({
204	    id: orderId,
205	    siteId,
206	    vendor: bill.vendor_name,
207	    billNumber: bill.bill_number,
208	    billDate: bill.bill_date,
209	    billPhotoUrl: billPhotoUrl ?? null,
210	    grandTotal: bill.grand_total,
211	    expectedAt: bill.bill_date ?? new Date().toISOString(),
212	  });
213	
214	  const results: Array<{
215	    lineItem: BillLineItem;
216	    match: MatchResult;
217	    orderItemId: string | null;
218	  }> = [];
219	
220	  let matchedCount = 0;
221	  let unresolvedCount = 0;
222	
223	  for (const lineItem of bill.line_items) {
224	    const match = await matchBillLineToProduct(siteId, lineItem);
225	
226	    if (match.matched && match.productId) {
227	      // Create order item linked to canonical product
228	      const orderItemId = `oi_${nanoid(12)}`;
229	      await createOrderItemFromBill({
230	        id: orderItemId,

233	        productName: match.canonicalName,
234	        billItemName: lineItem.item_purchased,
235	        hsnCode: lineItem.hsn_code,
236	        expectedQty: lineItem.qty,
237	        unitRate: lineItem.rate,
238	        lineValue: lineItem.value,
239	        matchMethod: match.method,
240	        matchConfidence: match.confidence,
241	      });
242	
243	      results.push({ lineItem, match, orderItemId });
244	      matchedCount++;
245	    } else {
246	      // Queue for admin resolution
247	      const unresolvedId = `ubli_${nanoid(12)}`;
248	      await insertUnresolvedBillItem({
249	        id: unresolvedId,
250	        siteId,
251	        orderId,
252	        billItemName: lineItem.item_purchased,
253	        hsnCode: lineItem.hsn_code,
254	        qty: lineItem.qty,
255	        unitRate: lineItem.rate,
256	        lineValue: lineItem.value,
257	      });
258	
259	      results.push({ lineItem, match, orderItemId: null });
260	      unresolvedCount++;
261	    }
262	  }
263	
264	  return {
265	    orderId,
266	    results,
267	    summary: {
268	      total: bill.line_items.length,
269	      matched: matchedCount,
270	      unresolved: unresolvedCount,
271	    },
272	  };
273	}

  "old_string": "/**\n * Process an entire extracted bill: match each line item, create\n * an order, and queue unresolved items for admin resolution.",
  "new_string": "export type ValidatedBillItem = {\n  /** \"use_existing\" maps the bill line to a known canonical_product.\n   *  \"create_new\" registers a new canonical_product. */\n  action: \"use_existing\" | \"create_new\";\n  product_id?: string | null; // required when action = \"use_existing\"\n  canonical_name: string;\n  category?: string | null;\n  hsn_code?: string | null;\n  unit: string;\n  pack_size: number;\n  qty: number;\n  rate?: number | null;\n  value?: number | null;\n  bill_item_name: string; // verbatim from the bill — saved as alias\n};\n\nexport type ValidatedBill = {\n  vendor_name?: string | null;\n  bill_number?: string | null;\n  bill_date?: string | null;\n  bill_photo_url?: string | null;\n  grand_total?: number | null;\n  items: ValidatedBillItem[];\n};\n\n/**\n * Commit an admin-validated bill: create new canonical products as\n * needed, write the order + order_items, save aliases. Returns the\n * created orderId + per-item commit info so the caller can append\n * to the \"Ordered\" Google Sheet tab.\n */\nexport async function processValidatedBill(\n  siteId: string,\n  createdBy: string,\n  bill: ValidatedBill,\n): Promise<{\n  orderId: string;\n  committed: Array<{\n    productId: string;\n    canonicalName: string;\n    unit: string;\n    packSize: number;\n    billItemName: string;\n    hsnCode: string | null;\n    qty: number;\n    rate: number | null;\n    value: number | null;\n  }>;\n}> {\n  const orderId = `ord_${nanoid(12)}`;\n  await createOrderFromBill({\n    id: orderId,\n    siteId,\n    vendor: bill.vendor_name ?? null,\n    billNumber: bill.bill_number ?? null,\n    billDate: bill.bill_date ?? null,\n    billPhotoUrl: bill.bill_photo_url ?? null,\n    grandTotal: bill.grand_total ?? null,\n    expectedAt: bill.bill_date ?? new Date().toISOString(),\n  });\n\n  const committed: Array<{\n    productId: string;\n    canonicalName: string;\n    unit: string;\n    packSize: number;\n    billItemName: string;\n    hsnCode: string | null;\n    qty: number;\n    rate: number | null;\n    value: number | null;\n  }> = [];\n\n  for (const item of bill.items) {\n    let productId = item.product_id ?? null;\n    let canonicalName = item.canonical_name;\n    let unit = item.unit;\n    let packSize = item.pack_size;\n\n    if (item.action === \"create_new\" || !productId) {\n      productId = `prod_${nanoid(10)}`;\n      await upsertCanonicalProduct({\n        productId,\n        siteId,\n        canonicalName,\n        category: item.category ?? null,\n        hsnCode: item.hsn_code ?? null,\n        unit,\n        packSize,\n        createdBy,\n      });\n    } else {\n      // use_existing — keep server canonical_name / unit / pack_size canonical\n      // but record what the admin saw. If admin edited canonical_name, the\n      // existing canonical product takes precedence (don't silently rename\n      // catalog rows under the admin).\n      const existing = await findCanonicalProductByName(siteId, canonicalName);\n      if (existing) {\n        productId = existing.product_id;\n        unit = existing.unit;\n        packSize = existing.pack_size;\n        canonicalName = existing.canonical_name;\n      }\n    }\n\n    // Save the alias so this vendor's variant of the name auto-resolves next time\n    if (item.bill_item_name && item.bill_item_name.trim() !== canonicalName) {\n      try {\n        await saveProductAlias({\n          id: `pa_${nanoid(12)}`,\n          siteId,\n          rawName: item.bill_item_name,\n          productId,\n          hsnCode: item.hsn_code ?? null,\n          confidence: 1.0,\n          source: \"admin_validated\",\n        });\n      } catch {\n        // unique-violation on rawname+hsn is fine — already learned\n      }\n    }\n\n    const orderItemId = `oi_${nanoid(12)}`;\n    await createOrderItemFromBill({\n      id: orderItemId,\n      orderId,\n      productId,\n      productName: canonicalName,\n      billItemName: item.bill_item_name,\n      hsnCode: item.hsn_code ?? null,\n      expectedQty: item.qty,\n      unitRate: item.rate ?? null,\n      lineValue: item.value ?? null,\n      matchMethod: item.action === \"create_new\" ? \"admin_new\" : \"admin_validated\",\n      matchConfidence: 1.0,\n    });\n\n    committed.push({\n      productId,\n      canonicalName,\n      unit,\n      packSize,\n      billItemName: item.bill_item_name,\n      hsnCode: item.hsn_code ?? null,\n      qty: item.qty,\n      rate: item.rate ?? null,\n      value: item.value ?? null,\n    });\n  }\n\n  return { orderId, committed };\n}\n\n/**\n * Process an entire extracted bill: match each line item, create\n * an order, and queue unresolved items for admin resolution."
}

241	
242	  const items = unresolvedQuery.data?.data?.items ?? [];
243	  const products = productsQuery.data?.data?.products ?? [];
244	
245	  const resolveMutation = useMutation({
246	    mutationFn: resolveBillItem,
247	    onSuccess: (res) => {

249	      toastSuccess("Item resolved");
250	      void queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["inv-unresolved"] });
251	    },

Field-app guards then see these as expected deliveries.\n            </div>\n          </div>\n        </div>\n      )}\n\n      {extracted && billMeta && (\n        <div>\n          <div style={{ display: \"flex\", justifyContent: \"space-between\", alignItems: \"flex-end\", marginBottom: 12, gap: 10, flexWrap: \"wrap\" }}>\n            <div>\n              <div style={{ fontSize: 12, color: \"var(--muted)\", textTransform: \"uppercase\", letterSpacing: 0.5 }}>Review extracted bill</div>\n              <div style={{ display: \"flex\", gap: 16, marginTop: 4, fontSize: 13 }}>\n                <BillField label=\"Vendor\" value={billMeta.vendor_name} onChange={(v) => setBillMeta({ ...billMeta, vendor_name: v })} />\n                <BillField label=\"Bill #\" value={billMeta.bill_number} onChange={(v) => setBillMeta({ ...billMeta, bill_number: v })} />\n                <BillField label=\"Date\" value={billMeta.bill_date} onChange={(v) => setBillMeta({ ...billMeta, bill_date: v })} type=\"date\" />\n              </div>\n            </div>\n            <div style={{ display: \"flex\", gap: 8 }}>\n              <button type=\"button\" onClick={() => { setBillMeta(null); setRows([]); }} style={ghostBtn}>\n                Discard\n              </button>\n              <button\n                type=\"button\"\n                className=\"primary-button\"\n                disabled={rows.length === 0 || validateMutation.isPending}\n                onClick={() => validateMutation.mutate()}\n              >\n                {validateMutation.isPending ? \"Saving…\" : `Validate & save (${rows.length})`}\n              </button>\n            </div>\n          </div>\n\n          <div style={{ display: \"grid\", gap: 10 }}>\n            {rows.map((r) => (\n              <ReviewRowCard\n                key={r.tempId}\n                row={r}\n                onChange={(patch) => patchRow(r.tempId, patch)}\n                onAcceptSuggestion={(s) => acceptSuggestion(r.tempId, s)}\n                onRemove={() => removeRow(r.tempId)}\n              />\n            ))}\n            {rows.length === 0 && (\n              <div style={{ padding: 14, border: \"1px dashed var(--line)\", borderRadius: 8, color: \"var(--muted)\", fontSize: 13, textAlign: \"center\" }}>\n                All rows removed. Discard and re-upload, or go to <button type=\"button\" onClick={() => goToTab(\"products\")} style={linkBtn}>Catalog</button>.\n              </div>\n            )}\n          </div>\n        </div>\n      )}\n    </div>\n  );\n}\n\nfunction itemToRow(it: BillExtractItem): ReviewRow {\n  // If there's a strong suggestion (>= 0.85), pre-fill action=use_existing\n  const top = it.suggestions[0];\n  const useTop = top && top.score >= 0.85;\n  return {\n    tempId: it.tempId,\n    bill_item_name: it.bill_item_name,\n    canonical_name: useTop ? top.canonicalName : it.bill_item_name,\n    hsn_code: it.hsn_code ?? top?.hsnCode ?? \"\",\n    qty: it.qty,\n    rate: it.rate,\n    value: it.value,\n    unit: useTop ? top.unit : (it.unit_hint && UNIT_OPTIONS.includes(it.unit_hint) ? it.unit_hint : \"pcs\"),\n    pack_size: useTop ? top.packSize : 1,\n    action: useTop ? \"use_existing\" : \"create_new\",\n    product_id: useTop ? top.productId : null,\n    suggestions: it.suggestions,\n  };\n}\n\nfunction BillField({\n  label, value, onChange, type = \"text\",\n}: { label: string; value: string | null; onChange: (v: string | null) => void; type?: string }) {\n  return (\n    <label style={{ display: \"grid\", gap: 2 }}>\n      <span style={{ fontSize: 10, color: \"var(--muted)\", textTransform: \"uppercase\", letterSpacing: 0.5 }}>{label}</span>\n      <input\n        type={type}\n        value={value ?? \"\"}\n        onChange={(e) => onChange(e.target.value || null)}\n        style={{ ...input, fontSize: 13, padding: \"4px 8px\", minWidth: 120 }}\n      />\n    </label>\n  );\n}\n\nfunction ReviewRowCard({\n  row, onChange, onAcceptSuggestion, onRemove,\n}: {\n  row: ReviewRow;\n  onChange: (patch: Partial<ReviewRow>) => void;\n  onAcceptSuggestion: (s: BillSuggestion) => void;\n  onRemove: () => void;\n}) {\n  const top = row.suggestions[0];\n  const isUsingExisting = row.action === \"use_existing\" && row.product_id;\n  return (\n    <div style={{ border: \"1px solid var(--line)\", borderRadius: 10, padding: 12 }}>\n      <div style={{ display: \"flex\", justifyContent: \"space-between\", alignItems: \"flex-start\", marginBottom: 8 }}>\n        <div style={{ fontSize: 11, color: \"var(--muted)\" }}>\n          From bill: <b>{row.bill_item_name}</b>\n        </div>\n        <div style={{ display: \"flex\", gap: 6, alignItems: \"center\" }}>\n          {isUsingExisting ? (\n            <Pill ok>Mapped to catalog</Pill>\n          ) : (\n            <Pill warn>Will register as new</Pill>\n          )}\n          <button type=\"button\" onClick={onRemove} style={{ ...ghostBtn, padding: \"4px 8px\", fontSize: 11 }}>Remove</button>\n        </div>\n      </div>\n\n      <div style={{ display: \"grid\", gap: 8, gridTemplateColumns: \"2fr 1fr 1fr 1fr 1fr 1fr\", alignItems: \"end\" }}>\n        <FieldLabel label=\"Canonical name\">\n          <input\n            type=\"text\"\n            value={row.canonical_name}\n            onChange={(e) => onChange({ canonical_name: e.target.value, action: \"create_new\", product_id: null })}\n            style={input}\n          />\n        </FieldLabel>\n        <FieldLabel label=\"HSN\">\n          <input type=\"text\" value={row.hsn_code} onChange={(e) => onChange({ hsn_code: e.target.value })} style={input} />\n        </FieldLabel>\n        <FieldLabel label=\"Qty\">\n          <input type=\"number\" step=\"any\" value={row.qty} onChange={(e) => onChange({ qty: Number(e.target.value) || 0 })} style={input} />\n        </FieldLabel>\n        <FieldLabel label=\"Rate (₹)\">\n          <input type=\"number\" step=\"any\" value={row.rate ?? \"\"} onChange={(e) => onChange({ rate: e.target.value === \"\" ? null : Number(e.target.value) })} style={input} />\n        </FieldLabel>\n        <FieldLabel label=\"Unit\">\n          <select value={row.unit} onChange={(e) => onChange({ unit: e.target.value })} style={input}>\n            {UNIT_OPTIONS.map((u) => <option key={u} value={u}>{u}</option>)}\n          </select>\n        </FieldLabel>\n        <FieldLabel label=\"Pack size\">\n          <input type=\"number\" step=\"any\" value={row.pack_size} onChange={(e) => onChange({ pack_size: Number(e.target.value) || 1 })} style={input} />\n        </FieldLabel>\n      </div>\n\n      {row.suggestions.length > 0 && (\n        <div style={{ marginTop: 10 }}>\n          <div style={{ fontSize: 11, color: \"var(--muted)\", marginBottom: 4 }}>Catalog suggestions:</div>\n          <div style={{ display: \"flex\", gap: 6, flexWrap: \"wrap\" }}>\n            {row.suggestions.map((s) => {\n              const active = row.product_id === s.productId;\n              return (\n                <button\n                  key={s.productId}\n                  type=\"button\"\n                  onClick={() => onAcceptSuggestion(s)}\n                  style={{\n                    border: \"1px solid var(--line)\",\n                    borderRadius: 6,\n                    padding: \"6px 10px\",\n                    background: active ? \"var(--text)\" : \"transparent\",\n                    color: active ? \"var(--surface, #fff)\" : \"var(--text)\",\n                    cursor: \"pointer\",\n                    fontSize: 12,\n                    display: \"inline-flex\",\n                    gap: 6,\n                    alignItems: \"center\",\n                  }}\n                >\n                  {active && <Check size={12} />}\n                  <span style={{ fontWeight: 600 }}>{s.canonicalName}</span>\n                  <span style={{ opacity: 0.8 }}>· {s.packSize} {s.unit}</span>\n                  <span style={{ opacity: 0.7 }}>· {Math.round(s.score * 100)}% {s.method}</span>\n                </button>\n              );\n            })}\n            <button\n              type=\"button\"\n              onClick={() => onChange({ action: \"create_new\", product_id: null })}\n              style={{\n                border: \"1px dashed var(--line)\",\n                borderRadius: 6,\n                padding: \"6px 10px\",\n                background: row.action === \"create_new\" ? \"var(--text)\" : \"transparent\",\n                color: row.action === \"create_new\" ? \"var(--surface, #fff)\" : \"var(--muted)\",\n                cursor: \"pointer\",\n                fontSize: 12,\n              }}\n            >\n              {top ? \"None — register new\" : \"Register as new product\"}\n            </button>\n          </div>\n        </div>\n      )}\n    </div>\n  );\n}"
}

All three projects clean. **Restart `office-ops-engine` for the new endpoints to take effect.** Field-app and dashboard hot-reload.

**What's now in place:**

**Backend**
- `POST /api/inventory/bills/extract` — OCR-only. Returns `{ bill, items[] }` where each item carries the raw bill fields plus up to 3 catalog `suggestions` ranked by score+method (exact / alias / hsn_fuzzy / normalized / global_fuzzy). No DB writes.
- `POST /api/inventory/bills/validate` — admin sends the edited list back. Each row has `action: "use_existing" | "create_new"`. Server creates new canonical products as needed, writes the order + order_items, saves aliases. Appends every row to the `Ordered` Google Sheet tab.
- Old `POST /api/inventory/bills` still works as an alias for `extract` (back-compat).
- Receipts now append to `Received` (was `Inventory Compliance`); the sheet-info endpoint returns `tabs: ["Ordered", "Received"]`.
- `processBill` / `findOpenItemByProductId` etc. unchanged.

**Dashboard (Bill Upload tab)**
- **Step 1:** drop file → "Extract items".
- **Step 2:** an editable card per line item with: canonical name, HSN, qty, rate, unit (select), pack_size. Plus a row of clickable suggestion chips ("Wagh Bakri Chai · 1 kg · 92% hsn_fuzzy") and a "Register as new" chip. Choosing a suggestion locks the row to that product; editing the name flips back to "Register new". A pill at top-right shows "Mapped to catalog" or "Will register as new".
- **Validate & save (N)** commits everything in one call, clears the form, refetches Catalog.

**Field app**
- `CatalogPicker`: right side now shows `pack_size unit` (e.g. `1 kg`) on every row.
- `ReceivingScreen`: header shows the product name on the left and `pack_size unit` aligned on the right.

**Open / not yet done**
- Sheet attach/detach UI (you mentioned wanting it). Right now sheet linkage is via env vars (`GOOGLE_SHEETS_ID` + service account). To add attach/detach we'd persist the sheet ID in `inventory_settings` per-site and let admin paste a URL. Want me to add that next, or is env enough for v1?
- The "Unresolved" tab in the dashboard is now mostly redundant — every bill goes through the validation flow, so nothing should land in `unresolved_bill_items` anymore. Keep the tab for legacy data (rows from the older auto-match flow), or hide it?

270	function buildTelegramLink(chatId: unknown, msgId: unknown): string {
271	  if (!chatId || !msgId) return '';
272	  const absId = Math.abs(Number(chatId));
273	  const idStr = String(absId);
274	  const cleanId = idStr.startsWith('100') && idStr.length > 10 ? idStr.slice(3) : idStr;
275	  return `https://t.me/c/${cleanId}/${msgId}`;
276	}

278	function formatSheetRange(sheetTitle: string, range: string): string {
279	  const escapedTitle = sheetTitle.replace(/'/g, "''");
280	  return `'${escapedTitle}'!${range}`;

  "new_string": "  // ── Google Sheet attach / detach (per-site) ─────────────────\n  //   GET    /api/inventory/sheet              — current attached sheet\n  //   POST   /api/inventory/sheet  { url|id }  — attach\n  //   DELETE /api/inventory/sheet              — detach\n  //   POST   /api/inventory/sheet/sync         — backfill range to Received\n  if (pathname === \"/api/inventory/sheet\" && method === \"GET\") {\n    const auth = await authenticate(req, res);\n    if (!auth) return true;\n    const spreadsheetId = await getSetting(auth.siteId, SHEET_ID_KEY);\n    const credentialsAvailable = Boolean(\n      process.env.GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY_JSON ||\n        process.env.GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY_PATH,\n    );\n    json(res, 200, {\n      attached: Boolean(spreadsheetId),\n      spreadsheetId,\n      url: spreadsheetId\n        ? `https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/${spreadsheetId}/edit`\n        : null,\n      credentialsAvailable,\n      tabs: [\"Ordered\", \"Received\"],\n    });\n    return true;\n  }\n\n  if (pathname === \"/api/inventory/sheet\" && method === \"POST\") {\n    const auth = await authenticate(req, res);\n    if (!auth) return true;\n    const body = await readBodyJson(req);\n    const raw = asString(body.url) ?? asString(body.spreadsheet_id) ?? asString(body.id);\n    if (!raw) {\n      json(res, 400, { error: \"url or spreadsheet_id is required\" });\n      return true;\n    }\n    // Accept either a full sheet URL or a bare id.\n    // URL formats: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/<ID>/edit#...\n    const match = raw.match(/\\/spreadsheets\\/d\\/([a-zA-Z0-9_-]+)/);\n    const spreadsheetId = match ? match[1] : raw.trim();\n    if (!/^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{20,}$/.test(spreadsheetId)) {\n      json(res, 400, { error: \"Could not parse a valid Google Sheet ID from input\" });\n      return true;\n    }\n\n    const verification = await verifySpreadsheetAccess(spreadsheetId);\n    if (!verification.ok) {\n      json(res, 400, {\n        error:\n          verification.error?.includes(\"not configured\")\n            ? \"Server's Google service-account credentials are not configured.\"\n            : `Cannot access this sheet. Share it with the service account first. (${verification.error})`,\n      });\n      return true;\n    }\n\n    await setSetting(auth.siteId, SHEET_ID_KEY, spreadsheetId);\n    json(res, 200, {\n      attached: true,\n      spreadsheetId,\n      title: verification.title ?? null,\n      url: `https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/${spreadsheetId}/edit`,\n    });\n    return true;\n  }\n\n  if (pathname === \"/api/inventory/sheet\" && method === \"DELETE\") {\n    const auth = await authenticate(req, res);\n    if (!auth) return true;\n    await deleteSetting(auth.siteId, SHEET_ID_KEY);\n    json(res, 200, { attached: false });\n    return true;\n  }\n\n  if (pathname === \"/api/inventory/sheet/sync\" && method === \"POST\") {\n    const auth = await authenticate(req, res);\n    if (!auth) return true;\n    const spreadsheetId = await getSetting(auth.siteId, SHEET_ID_KEY);\n    if (!spreadsheetId) {\n      json(res, 400, { error: \"No Google Sheet attached for this site\" });\n      return true;\n    }\n    const body = await readBodyJson(req);\n    const from = asString(body.from);\n    const to = asString(body.to);\n    const rows = await listComplianceLog(auth.siteId, from, to);\n    let appended = 0;\n    let failed = 0;\n    for (const r of rows) {\n      try {\n        await appendInventoryRow(\n          spreadsheetId,\n          \"Received\",\n          INVENTORY_SHEET_HEADERS.Received,\n          complianceRowToSheetValues(r),\n        );\n        appended++;\n      } catch (err) {\n        logError(\"[Inventory] sheet sync row failed\", err, { scope: \"inventory.sheets\" });\n        failed++;\n      }\n    }\n    json(res, 200, { appended, failed, total: rows.length });\n    return true;\n  }"
}

> AGENT

All green. **Restart `office-ops-engine`** for the new schema + endpoints.

**What's new:**

**Backend**
- New table `inventory_settings (site_id, key, value)` — per-site key-value store.
- New endpoints, all admin-authed and site-scoped:
  - `GET    /api/inventory/sheet` → `{ attached, spreadsheetId, url, credentialsAvailable, tabs: ["Ordered","Received"] }`
  - `POST   /api/inventory/sheet` `{ url | spreadsheet_id }` → parses URL or bare ID, verifies access via service-account, then stores it.
  - `DELETE /api/inventory/sheet` → detaches (existing rows in the sheet are kept; the backend just stops appending).
  - `POST   /api/inventory/sheet/sync` `{ from?, to? }` → backfills `Received` tab from the compliance log.
- `appendInventoryRow(spreadsheetId, tab, headers, row)` and `verifySpreadsheetAccess(id)` in `lib/google-sheets.ts`. Auth (service-account) still comes from env (`GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY_PATH` / `GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY_JSON`); only the spreadsheet ID is per-site.
- Receipt insert and bill validation now load the site's spreadsheet ID from settings (if any) — no env-based sheet ID is read anywhere in the inventory path.

**Dashboard (Compliance tab)**
- Top card replaces the old static link. Two states:
  - **Not attached:** text field for sheet URL or ID + "Attach" button. On submit, server verifies access; toast tells you to share the sheet with the service account if it can't.
  - **Attached:** shows ID, "Open sheet ↗", "Sync range to sheet" (uses the date filters below), and "Detach" (with confirm).
- If service-account creds are missing on the backend, a warning explains why "Attach" is disabled.

**Caveat to call out to the admin:** sharing the sheet with the service-account email is a one-time step — copy the service-account email from the JSON key, then share the sheet as Editor. After that, every bill validation appends to `Ordered` and every gate receipt appends to `Received`.

Unlike `appendToSheetDirect`\n * this takes the spreadsheetId from the caller (used for per-site\n * attached sheets stored in `inventory_settings`).\n */\nexport async function appendInventoryRow(\n  spreadsheetId: string,\n  tabName: string,\n  headers: string[],\n  rowData: string[],\n): Promise<void> {\n  const sheets = await getAuthOnlySheetsClient();\n  if (!sheets) throw new Error('Google service-account credentials not configured');\n\n  await ensureSheet(sheets, spreadsheetId, tabName);\n\n  try {\n    const headerCheck = await sheets.spreadsheets.values.get({\n      spreadsheetId,\n      range: formatSheetRange(tabName, 'A1:A1'),\n    });\n    const hasHeaders = (headerCheck.data.values?.[0]?.length ?? 0) > 0;\n    if (!hasHeaders) {\n      await sheets.spreadsheets.values.update({\n        spreadsheetId,\n        range: formatSheetRange(tabName, 'A1'),\n        valueInputOption: 'USER_ENTERED',\n        requestBody: { values: [headers] },\n      });\n    }\n  } catch {\n    // non-critical\n  }\n\n  await sheets.spreadsheets.values.append({\n    spreadsheetId,\n    range: formatSheetRange(tabName, 'A:A'),\n    valueInputOption: 'USER_ENTERED',\n    insertDataOption: 'INSERT_ROWS',\n    requestBody: { values: [rowData] },\n  });\n}\n\n/**\n * Verify the caller has access to a spreadsheet — used by the dashboard\n * \"Attach\" button to confirm the URL is valid before saving the id.\n */\nexport async function verifySpreadsheetAccess(\n  spreadsheetId: string,\n): Promise<{ ok: boolean; title?: string; error?: string }> {\n  const sheets = await getAuthOnlySheetsClient();\n  if (!sheets) return { ok: false, error: 'service-account credentials not configured' };\n  try {\n    const meta = await sheets.spreadsheets.get({ spreadsheetId });\n    return { ok: true, title: meta.data.properties?.title ?? undefined };\n  } catch (err) {\n    return {\n      ok: false,\n      error: err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err),\n    };\n  }\n}",

The client must already be\n * authorized for `spreadsheetId` (e.g. built from an OAuth refresh\n * token via buildOAuthClientWithRefreshToken).\n */\nexport async function appendInventoryRow(\n  sheets: sheets_v4.Sheets,\n  spreadsheetId: string,\n  tabName: string,\n  headers: string[],\n  rowData: string[],\n): Promise<void> {\n  await ensureSheet(sheets, spreadsheetId, tabName);\n\n  try {\n    const headerCheck = await sheets.spreadsheets.values.get({\n      spreadsheetId,\n      range: formatSheetRange(tabName, 'A1:A1'),\n    });\n    const hasHeaders = (headerCheck.data.values?.[0]?.length ?? 0) > 0;\n    if (!hasHeaders) {\n      await sheets.spreadsheets.values.update({\n        spreadsheetId,\n        range: formatSheetRange(tabName, 'A1'),\n        valueInputOption: 'USER_ENTERED',\n        requestBody: { values: [headers] },\n      });\n    }\n  } catch {\n    // non-critical\n  }\n\n  await sheets.spreadsheets.values.append({\n    spreadsheetId,\n    range: formatSheetRange(tabName, 'A:A'),\n    valueInputOption: 'USER_ENTERED',\n    insertDataOption: 'INSERT_ROWS',\n    requestBody: { values: [rowData] },\n  });\n}\n\n/**\n * Verify the supplied sheets client can read a spreadsheet — used by\n * the dashboard \"Attach\" button to confirm the URL is valid before\n * saving the id.\n */\nexport async function verifySpreadsheetAccess(\n  sheets: sheets_v4.Sheets,\n  spreadsheetId: string,\n): Promise<{ ok: boolean; title?: string; error?: string }> {\n  try {\n    const meta = await sheets.spreadsheets.get({ spreadsheetId });\n    return { ok: true, title: meta.data.properties?.title ?? undefined };\n  } catch (err) {\n    return {\n      ok: false,\n      error: err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err),\n    };\n  }\n}"

  "old_string": "const SHEET_ID_KEY = \"google_sheet_id\";\n\nasync function appendComplianceRow(siteId: string, receiptId: string): Promise<void> {\n  const spreadsheetId = await getSetting(siteId, SHEET_ID_KEY);\n  if (!spreadsheetId) return; // no sheet attached for this site\n  const row = await getComplianceLogForReceipt(siteId, receiptId);\n  if (!row) return;\n  await appendInventoryRow(\n    spreadsheetId,\n    \"Received\",\n    INVENTORY_SHEET_HEADERS.Received,\n    complianceRowToSheetValues(row),\n  );\n}",
  "new_string": "const SHEET_ID_KEY = \"google_sheet_id\";\nconst SHEET_OWNER_KEY = \"google_sheet_owner_email\";\n\n/**\n * Build a Sheets API client authorized as the given admin user, using\n * their stored Google OAuth refresh token. Returns null if the user\n * has no Google token on file — caller decides whether that's an error.\n */\nasync function getAdminSheetsClient(adminEmail: string) {\n  const db = getOptionalPostgresDb();\n  if (!db) return null;\n  const rows = await db\n    .select({ refresh: users.googleRefreshToken })\n    .from(users)\n    .where(eq(users.email, adminEmail.trim().toLowerCase()))\n    .limit(1);\n  const refresh = rows[0]?.refresh ?? null;\n  if (!refresh) return null;\n  return google.sheets({\n    version: \"v4\",\n    auth: buildOAuthClientWithRefreshToken(refresh),\n  });\n}\n\nasync function appendComplianceRow(siteId: string, receiptId: string): Promise<void> {\n  const [spreadsheetId, ownerEmail] = await Promise.all([\n    getSetting(siteId, SHEET_ID_KEY),\n    getSetting(siteId, SHEET_OWNER_KEY),\n  ]);\n  if (!spreadsheetId || !ownerEmail) return; // no sheet attached\n  const sheets = await getAdminSheetsClient(ownerEmail);\n  if (!sheets) return; // owner's Google token missing — silently skip\n  const row = await getComplianceLogForReceipt(siteId, receiptId);\n  if (!row) return;\n  await appendInventoryRow(\n    sheets,\n    spreadsheetId,\n    \"Received\",\n    INVENTORY_SHEET_HEADERS.Received,\n    complianceRowToSheetValues(row),\n  );\n}"
}

> AGENT

All clean. **Restart the backend** for the new schema columns + endpoints to take effect.

**What changed:**

- The sheet now uses the **attaching admin's own Google OAuth refresh token** (same mechanism as Visitor → Bulk Invite). No more service-account sharing.
- `inventory_settings` stores two keys per site: `google_sheet_id` and `google_sheet_owner_email`. Receipts and bill validations look up the owner's refresh token to write rows.
- `GET /api/inventory/sheet` now returns `googleSsoConfigured` (env-level) and `callerHasGoogleToken` (user-level), so the dashboard can guide the admin precisely:
  - **No Google SSO env vars** → backend warning.
  - **Has env, but admin hasn't signed in with Google** → "Sign in with Google (top-right) before attaching."
  - **Ready** → paste URL → Attach.
- Detach clears both `google_sheet_id` and `google_sheet_owner_email`.
- If the owner's Google token later expires (they're deprovisioned or revoke), writes silently no-op for receipts and surface a clear error during validate/sync ("(owner email) needs to sign in with Google again").

One thing to verify on your side: the existing Google SSO at the top-right of the dashboard already requests the `spreadsheets` scope when admins consent (check `buildAuthorizationUrl` in `google-oauth.ts`). If it only requests profile/email scopes, attach will fail with a permissions error; in that case we'd need to broaden the scope and have admins re-sign-in.

> AGENT

You've hit a real bug. The form was *auto-filling* every editable field from the highest-scoring suggestion when `score >= 0.85`. Your DB has some poisoned alias rows (raw_name → wrong product_id, confidence 1.0) — probably from earlier test runs of the old `processBill` flow or earlier validations where the wrong suggestion got accepted without correction. So extraction → alias lookup → wrong product → form filled with wrong fields.

**Fix the auto-fill first** so the form always shows what the bill actually said. Suggestions remain visible but only apply when the admin clicks one.

> AGENT

Both clean. Restart the backend so the new `DELETE /api/inventory/aliases` endpoint mounts.

**What changed and why your bill looked wrong:**

1. **No more auto-fill.** Every editable field on a review row now starts with what the bill actually said (`canonical_name = bill_item_name`, `hsn_code = extracted HSN`, `unit = LLM's unit hint or pcs`, `pack_size = 1`, `action = create_new`). Suggestions still show as clickable chips beneath the row — admin chooses one explicitly to map.
2. **Root cause** of the wrong fill was a poisoned `product_aliases` table. The old `processBill` flow used to auto-save aliases from HSN-fuzzy and LLM-normalize steps without admin review. Those bad mappings (e.g. `raw_name = "premia elachi masala - 100gm"` → Amul Pure Ghee Tin) live on, and the new suggester returns them at confidence 1.0 because `source = "admin_validated"` or `1.0` default.
3. **Recovery:** Catalog tab → "Clear learned aliases" button drops every alias row for the site. Canonical products and barcode mappings are untouched. After this, suggestions will rebuild only from HSN-scoped fuzzy + LLM, and only the matches you accept during validation will become aliases.

Workflow after restart:
1. Restart backend.
2. Catalog tab → **Clear learned aliases** once.
3. Upload your test bill again — every row will show the bill's own text. Click suggestion chips only when they're actually right.

> AGENT

Lots to unpack. My quick take on your suggestion first:

> **Keep them separate.** "Orders" = source-of-truth list of admin-approved bills (what's expected to arrive, editable, deletable; field app reads from this). "Export" = read-only audit of what was actually scanned. They serve different purposes and putting both in one tab confuses "approved" with "received". I'll structure it that way.

For #4 (unit/pack_size in sheet) and #6 (no receipts visible) — likely site_id mismatch between field-app and dashboard, OR the receipt insert isn't capturing `product_id` so the join in `listComplianceLog` falls back to the legacy `product_name` and skips the canonical join. Let me wire diagnostics in too.

For #9/#10 (field-app not seeing catalog / not seeing deliveries) — likely the same site_id issue + the field-app's Orders screen reads from a different endpoint than our new orders. I'll investigate after the dashboard work.

Let me build, then verify.

> AGENT

**Found a smoking gun:** field-app uses `site-dev`, dashboard uses `default`. All your dashboard-created catalog and validated orders went into site `default`; the field-app guards write receipts to site `site-dev`. They never see each other. This alone explains #6 (no receipts visible), #9 (catalog not in field app), and #10 (delivery list not shown).

Fix: align the dashboard to `site-dev`.

[];\n    list.push(row);\n    itemsByOrder.set(row.order_id, list);\n  }\n  return orders.map((o) => ({ ...o, items: itemsByOrder.get(o.id) ?? [] }));\n}\n\nexport async function deleteOrder(siteId: string, orderId: string): Promise<{ deleted: boolean }> {\n  const db = await getDb();\n  // ON DELETE CASCADE on inventory_order_items removes the items.\n  // Receipts have a nullable FK so they're preserved (audit trail).\n  const result = await db.execute({\n    sql: `DELETE FROM inventory_orders WHERE id = ? AND site_id = ?`,\n    args: [orderId, siteId],\n  });\n  return { deleted: (result.rowsAffected ?? 0) > 0 };\n}\n\nexport async function updateOrderMeta(input: {\n  orderId: string;\n  siteId: string;\n  vendor?: string | null;\n  billNumber?: string | null;\n  billDate?: string | null;\n}): Promise<void> {\n  const db = await getDb();\n  await db.execute({\n    sql: `\n      UPDATE inventory_orders\n      SET vendor = COALESCE(?, vendor),\n          bill_number = COALESCE(?, bill_number),\n          bill_date = COALESCE(?, bill_date),\n          updated_at = now()\n      WHERE id = ? AND site_id = ?\n    `,\n    args: [\n      input.vendor ?? null,\n      input.billNumber ?? null,\n      input.billDate ?? null,\n      input.orderId,\n      input.siteId,\n    ],\n  });\n}\n\nexport async function updateOrderItem(input: {\n  itemId: string;\n  productId?: string | null;\n  productName?: string | null;\n  hsnCode?: string | null;\n  expectedQty?: number | null;\n  unitRate?: number | null;\n}): Promise<void> {\n  const db = await getDb();\n  await db.execute({\n    sql: `\n      UPDATE inventory_order_items\n      SET product_id = COALESCE(?, product_id),\n          product_name = COALESCE(?, product_name),\n          hsn_code = COALESCE(?, hsn_code),\n          expected_qty = COALESCE(?, expected_qty),\n          unit_rate = COALESCE(?, unit_rate)\n      WHERE id = ?\n    `,\n    args: [\n      input.productId ?? null,\n      input.productName ?? null,\n      input.hsnCode ?? null,\n      input.expectedQty ?? null,\n      input.unitRate ?? null,\n      input.itemId,\n    ],\n  });\n}\n\nexport async function deleteOrderItem(itemId: string): Promise<{ deleted: boolean }> {\n  const db = await getDb();\n  const result = await db.execute({\n    sql: `DELETE FROM inventory_order_items WHERE id = ?`,\n    args: [itemId],\n  });\n  return { deleted: (result.rowsAffected ?? 0) > 0 };\n}\n\n// ─── Site Settings (key-value) ───────────────────────────────────"
}

\"Unknown vendor\"} · {order.bill_number ?? \"—\"}\n            </div>\n            <div style={{ fontSize: 11, color: \"var(--muted)\" }}>\n              {order.bill_date ?? \"—\"} · {order.items.length} item{order.items.length === 1 ?
